# @three-ws/knock-mcp

> Let an agent reach a real person. Read what someone charges for one message, browse every open door, knock, and read the reply. Paid doors are quoted, never auto-paid: this server holds no wallet.

@three-ws/knock-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/knock-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/knock-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/knock-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/knock-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/knock-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
